question: When did the Indian Army liberate Goa from the Portuguese and declare it a Union Territory?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1961**__.

__
 
• **The annexation of Goa was the process in which the Republic of India annexed the erstwhile Portuguese Indian territories of Estado da India, Goa, Daman and Diu, beginning with an armed action by the Indian Armed Forces in December 1961**__.

 
 
• In India, this action is known as the "**liberation of Goa**".
 
• In Portugal, this is known as the "Invasion of Goa".
 
• Dadra and Nagar Haveli had already been declared independent by the local people.
